description: A landscape for Unreal Engine: an eroded massif on a heightfield of samples × samples heights, spacing apart (127, 253 or 505 a side: sizes Unreal Landscape takes as they are, 63 or 127 quads a section), with the weight layers grass, rock and road, a road on it, and trees and rocks as packed instances. The massif rises a little off the centre towards -Z: a peak with concave flanks under ridged noise, on gentle foothills; gullies are cut where the rain gathers (heightfield_flow), and a light droplet erosion, scaled to the map, wears it all; the ground runs from 0 to height. The road winds across the map along X over the massif's +Z flank: heightfield_path cuts a flat bed 6 m wide (at least 3 samples) with shoulders and a little banking, and marks it as the layer road; rock covers the slopes steeper than about 32 degrees off the road, grass the rest, so the three add up to 1. Trees (pine, fir and oak; oaks low down, conifers higher up, none above a tree line) stand in patches on the gentle grass, as full as tree_density says; rocks of three shapes lie in clusters on the rock layer, leaning with the slope, as many as rock_density says. Both are scattered on Unreal's own triangles (each cell cut along its (0,0)-(1,1) diagonal), so they stand exactly on the imported Landscape, and they keep the corners of their boxes, turned, tilted and scaled as placed, off the road surface. The road output is a ribbon along the road lying 5 cm above the ground. Asserts check that the landscape has samples × samples heights (fits_unreal), that no tree or rock reaches onto the road (clear_road) and that every one stands on the ground within 1 cm (grounded). Output level is all of it together, for the unreal_landscape export; node showcase (not an output) paints the landscape by its weight layers and puts the road, trees and rocks on it.

samples.label: samples
samples.desc: samples along each side: a size Unreal Landscape takes as it is

tree_density.label: tree density
tree_density.desc: how full the forest on the gentle ground is

rock_density.label: rock density
rock_density.desc: how many rocks lie on the steep slopes

road.label: road
road.desc: a road winding across the map

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: changes the mountains and the layout, not the look

field.note: 127, 253 or 505 samples a side: sizes Unreal Landscape takes as they are (63 or 127 quads a section)

eroded.note: light droplet erosion scaled to the map: the same rain on the same massif at any samples and spacing (radius, reach and droplets per m² follow the side, so every map gets about 1300 droplets a pass)

no_mask.note: one node per layer: heightfield_layer delete takes a single layer name, and a space-separated list silently deletes nothing

params.expression:
// rock on the steep slopes, off the paved strip
rock * (1 - path)

// grass on the rest
Math.max(0, 1 - rock - path)

// rocks in clusters on the rock layer
rock * rocky

tree_pick.note: xyzdist to the road strip, not to the course: xyzdist returns NaN on an open polyline

tree_gap.note: no assert compares points with a heightfield surface, so the ground under each instance is read from the grid here

tree_clear.note: distance to the road strip (polygons), not to the course: xyzdist and closest return NaN / prim -1 on an open polyline, and an attrib range assert lets NaN pass

params.names: ground_gap road_gap mask height variant yaw

rock_pick.note: xyzdist to the road strip, not to the course: xyzdist returns NaN on an open polyline

rock_gap.note: no assert compares points with a heightfield surface, so the ground under each instance is read from the grid here

rock_clear.note: distance to the road strip (polygons), not to the course: xyzdist and closest return NaN / prim -1 on an open polyline, and an attrib range assert lets NaN pass

params.names: ground_gap road_gap mask height slope variant yaw

road_up.note: a ribbon swept with up +Y faces -Y: turned to face up, as Unreal draws only the front

landscape.label: Landscape
landscape.description: The ground: samples × samples heights, spacing apart, with the weight layers grass, rock and road.

trees.label: Trees
trees.description: Pine, fir and oak trees on the gentle ground away from the road, packed instances standing on the landscape.

rocks.label: Rocks
rocks.description: Rocks of three shapes on the steep slopes, packed instances leaning with the ground.

road.label: Road
road.description: The road surface: a ribbon along the road, lying 5 cm above the ground; empty when road is off.

level.label: Level
level.description: The landscape with the road, trees and rocks on it, for the Unreal Landscape export.
